name: Konektor
description: Connect Claude to an authorized Konektor workspace to inspect leads, funnel performance, campaign outcomes, tracking health, and conversion-feedback status. The first release is read-only and supports workspace owners and admins on eligible Konektor plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Konektor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Konektor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.konektor.id/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Konektor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Konektor provides these MCP tools: analytics_campaigns, analytics_funnel, analytics_summary, feedback_pending, feedback_status, lead_get, leads_list, tracking_status, and workspace_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Konektor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Konektor in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Konektor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Konektor is developed by Konektor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
